report.scene_summary: The video shows an industrial manufacturing floor with large machinery, including a blue press, on the left side. A marked aisle with yellow and green painted lines runs along the right side. A worker is observed operating the blue press, and another worker walks through the aisle. A loose circular metal object is present on the floor near the machinery.

findings.title: Loose material on walking-working surface
findings.location: Floor area between the blue press and the marked aisle
findings.observation: A loose circular metal object is resting on the floor in an open area adjacent to the marked aisle. The object is not contained within a designated storage zone and is situated on the walking-working surface.
findings.risk_interpretation: Loose material left on a walking surface outside a marked storage area is a trip hazard under 1910.22(a)(3).
findings.applicability_reason: Loose material is on a walking-working surface outside a marked storage area.
recommended_actions: Relocate the loose object to a designated storage area.
Ensure all raw materials are stored in marked zones to keep walking surfaces clear.

zone_reviews.interpretation: Worker operating a large blue press machine.

dismissed.reason: Machinery is present, but no worker is visibly in danger or reaching into a hazard zone. No immediate violation observed.
No visible servicing or maintenance activity is occurring. The absence of a lock/tag does not establish a violation.
No visible eye/face hazard exposure is confirmed in the video frames.

limitations: No reliable floor-like mask found; static-zone ranking uses general scene candidates.
Machine operation status and energy isolation state are inferred from still frames and cannot be confirmed.
